title: Streak-forgiving habit tracker
goal: Give one person a daily checklist for six habits that keeps a streak alive through a missed day.
success: For two weeks the owner checks off today's habits in under 10 seconds each morning, and one missed day does not reset a streak.
users: One person (the requester), on a phone browser, opened once or twice a day.

must_have.item: Today screen listing the six habits with one tap to check each off
must_have.accept: Open the page, tap a habit, and see it marked done; reload and it is still marked.

must_have.item: Streak per habit with one grace day per week
must_have.accept: Skip one day: the streak keeps its count. Skip two days in one week: the streak resets to zero.
Check two habits, close the tab, reopen it: both are still checked.

must_have.item: Export all history to a CSV file
must_have.accept: Tap Export and open the file in a spreadsheet: one row per habit per day with a date and a done flag.

nice_to_have: Weekly view of the last 7 days
constraints: Free to host, no server to maintain
Works offline after the first visit

assumptions.text: Habits are daily only, not weekly or x-times-per-week.
The grace rule is one free miss per calendar week.
Data stays in the browser on one device, with no sync between phone and laptop.

reject_if: A missed day resets the streak on the first miss
Reaching any habit takes more than one screen
Reloading the page loses any check-off
open_risks: Clearing browser data erases history unless the owner exports regularly
